svg.title: TabPFN v3.5 vs TabFM
svg.desc: Model A: TabPFN v3.5 - classifier. Model B: TabFM - classifier. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted); E: embedding width. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); SwiGLU: gated linear unit with a Swish activation; LayerNorm: layer normalisation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; QK: query and key (as in QK-norm); KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input; ECDF: empirical cumulative distribution function. How to read: model A, its stages and its fact values; model B, its stages and its fact values; stages are paired by kind and attention axis, in order, not by name: a pair is the same kind of block in the same place, not necessarily the same design; matched: same kind and axis, and the same number of stacked blocks; only A / only B: a stage with no counterpart in the other model; facts: shared (the same value), different, or one side (reported by one model only, shown as --); on each card: × N stacked blocks and the axis its attention runs over, then its output shape; top right, its exact parameter count.
